My friend took her dog there a few months ago. They cut his neck badly and hid it with a bandana. When she noticed and called to report it, they treated her badly and made her feel like she was crazy. No one took responsibility or apologized. Despite that, I decided to give them a second chance, and my husband took our dog there this morning. They cut him badly on one of his testicles, and no one said a word. We only realized it when we got home because he was bleeding. When we called back, they acted like they didn't care. Please, if you love your pets, don't take them to that place. They don't know how to handle animals to cut their hair, and they don't even have the decency to inform the owners that something happened. I'm never going back to that place.

I have known and gone to this place since 2017. I like this place because they have reasonable prices. I think they have increased their prices recently. Before the nail cut is only $5/dog.
